responsibility: Render one production memory as a Focus surface with single-column content, persisted MemoryUserEdit/conflict state, typed source availability, capability-gated source actions, on-demand translation and provenance citation navigation. Citation entry is revalidated against current UserPolicy and FocusSourceResolver; it proves source identity, not automatic factual entailment. Original-source deletion is offered only for visible PhotoKit photo/video that pass PHAsset.canPerform(.delete).

inputs.memory: MemoryDetailModel mapped from CanonicalMemory + MemoryUserEdit + MemoryEditConflict. Original source content remains separate from user title/multiline description/normalized tags.
inputs.contentAvailability: available | offlineUnavailable | authorizationDenied | limitedScopeHidden | missing | unsupported
inputs.sourceDeletionCapability: removeFromEchoOnly | photoLibraryDeletable; deletion requires current UserPolicy, authorized/limited-visible PhotoKit access and PHAsset.canPerform(.delete); Share Extension sources never claim source-app deletion authority
inputs.deleteOriginalActionVisibility: memory-delete-delete-original is present if and only if sourceDeletionCapability=photoLibraryDeletable; fixture/service wiring alone does not decide visibility

outputs.visibleContent: PhotoKit content plus user edit overlay, translated/canonical text, grouped metadata, provenance-labelled Source memory anchors and capability-gated actions. Anchors do not claim automatic factual verification. Share text uses saved canonical content and Share audio is transcript-only because original audio is not persisted. Production media is resolved under current UserPolicy; offline, unresolved, revoked, limited-hidden and missing states remain distinct and never fall back to bundled samples.
outputs.interactionTargets: translateToggle, editButton, deleteButton, conflictActionButtons, saveButton, citationAnchor, retryButton, mediaPlayPause
outputs.accessibilityTree: Content in reading order; grouped metadata; media preview with label; each citation anchor as separate element

systemContainer: NavigationStack (pushed from Search/Home) + ScrollView + Form sheet for edit + Alert for delete confirmation
